prompt: We crossed two sorghum lines that differ in leaf lipid content and want about 200 RILs by selfing to F6 for QTL mapping. How should we do it?

source.citation: Falconer & Mackay 1996 (inbreeding under selfing); Yu et al. 2008, Genetics 178:539-551 (mapping populations)
source.basis: F_t = 1-(1/2)^t; SSD minimises selection during inbreeding

reference_plan.design: Single seed descent from F2 to F6 (~97% homozygous), starting with ~20-30% extra F2 plants to allow for losses; then phenotype RILs + both parents in an alpha-lattice.
reference_plan.layout: RIL trial: incomplete blocks of 10 (200 = 20 x 10), parents repeated in every block as checks; border ring.
reference_plan.replication: 2-3 reps per environment; at least 2 environments for QTL x E.
reference_plan.randomization: Random F2 plant to each SSD lineage; alpha-lattice randomization per environment.
reference_plan.analysis: BLUEs per RIL from mixed model, then QTL mapping (e.g. composite interval mapping) with environment terms.
pitfalls: Losing late or weak lines (biased RIL set)

notes: Bag panicles every generation; genotype a subset to confirm homozygosity.

prompt: Our new mouse line has been kept by brother-sister mating for 8 generations. Can we treat it as inbred and compare it with C57BL/6?

source.citation: Falconer & Mackay 1996; inbred strain convention of 20 generations of brother-sister mating

reference_plan.design: Not yet inbred (the convention is 20 generations). Compare against littermate controls rather than an unrelated strain, or genotype to measure residual heterozygosity.
reference_plan.layout: Littermates of each genotype housed mixed by litter.
reference_plan.replication: Several litters per genotype; litter as a random effect.
reference_plan.randomization: Allocate littermates to test order randomly.
pitfalls: Comparing an 8-generation line to C57BL/6 confounds background with the mutation

prompt: I want to estimate GCA and SCA among 8 maize inbreds with a half diallel, testing the F1s at 3 locations with 2 reps.

reference_plan.design: Griffing method 4 (no selfs, no reciprocals): 28 F1s; add parents as checks if seed allows.
reference_plan.layout: 28 hybrids + checks in an alpha-lattice per location (e.g. 30 entries, blocks of 5 or 6).
reference_plan.replication: 2 reps x 3 locations; more reps if SCA is the main target.
reference_plan.analysis: y ~ loc + rep(loc) + GCA_i + GCA_j + SCA_ij + GCA x loc (mixed model).
pitfalls: Crosses made in different seasons (seed effects)
Too few environments for GCA x E

notes: Make all crosses in one season and nursery.

prompt: Yield stability of 40 soybean varieties over 6 locations and 3 years, 4 reps per trial.

source.basis: FA models for GxE in MET

reference_plan.design: Same 40 varieties at every location-year; alpha-lattice (blocks of 8) per trial.
reference_plan.layout: Row x column coordinates at every site; border plots.
reference_plan.replication: 4 reps per trial; 18 environments supports an FA(2) model.
reference_plan.analysis: Mixed model with environment-specific residuals and FA(k) genotype x environment; stability from FA loadings.
pitfalls: Convenience sites not representing target environments

notes: Collect environmental covariates to explain the GxE.

prompt: We screen 60 sorghum lines for early biomass in the greenhouse under drought, then check whether it predicts drought response in the field.

source.citation: Peirone et al. 2018, Front Plant Sci 9:587
source.basis: Greenhouse early traits vs field drought susceptibility; validation on independent genotypes

reference_plan.design: Greenhouse: 60 lines x 2 water levels, RCBD with benches as blocks. Field: same 60 lines in managed-drought and irrigated trials at >= 2 sites. Hold out ~20 lines (or use a second panel) for validation.
reference_plan.layout: Gravimetric watering in large pots; field split-plot (water on main plots).
reference_plan.replication: Greenhouse 4-6 reps; field 3 reps per site.
reference_plan.randomization: Within bench and within field blocks.
reference_plan.analysis: BLUPs per environment; correlation (with CI) or bivariate mixed model between greenhouse trait and field drought response.
pitfalls: Discovering and validating on the same lines

notes: Define water-limited field environments objectively before comparing.

prompt: We have a 300-line sorghum diversity panel with GWAS hits for leaf lipid content and want RNA-seq of leaves for eQTL mapping and colocalization.

source.citation: Yu et al. 2006 (Q+K); Giambartolomei et al. 2014 (coloc); Kremling et al. 2018 (maize eQTL panel)
source.basis: Structure-corrected GWAS + matched-tissue expression + statistical colocalization

reference_plan.design: One RNA-seq library per genotype (genotypes are the replicates for eQTL), same leaf, stage and 2-hour window as the lipid sampling.
reference_plan.layout: Sample from the field alpha-lattice by block; library prep and sequencing lanes balanced across blocks and subpopulations.
reference_plan.replication: ~300 genotypes x 1; add replicate libraries for a subset (e.g. 10%) to estimate technical noise.
reference_plan.randomization: Harvest order by block; randomize library batch.
reference_plan.analysis: GWAS: y ~ SNP + Q + (1|K). eQTL per gene with PEER/PCs; colocalization (coloc) and TWAS for lipid hits.
pitfalls: Harvesting genotype groups on different days

notes: Match tissue and timing to where the lipid trait is measured.

prompt: Ribosome profiling of Arabidopsis seedlings under heat vs control with 3 biological replicates and matched RNA-seq.

source.citation: Eastman et al. 2018, Comput Struct Biotechnol J 16:167-176; Ingolia et al. 2009, Science 324:218-223
source.basis: Arrest, digestion, rRNA depletion, matched RNA-seq

reference_plan.design: Each replicate = independent seedling pool grown on a different plate/day; heat and control harvested side by side (day = block).
reference_plan.layout: Split each lysate into footprint and RNA-seq libraries.
reference_plan.replication: 3 biological replicates is a minimum; 4 if effects are subtle.
reference_plan.randomization: Library prep order randomized within day.
reference_plan.analysis: Interaction model footprints vs mRNA (xtail / RiboDiff / anota) with day as block.

notes: Flash-freeze rather than drug pre-treatment where possible.

prompt: ATAC-seq of maize roots across 3 water treatments with 2 biological replicates, plus RNA-seq from the same tissue.

source.citation: Lu et al. 2017, Nucleic Acids Res 45:e41; ENCODE ATAC-seq standards
source.basis: Nuclei purification, organellar reads, replicate/QC targets

reference_plan.design: 3 water levels x 3 biological replicates (2 is the ENCODE minimum; 3 gives power for differential peaks); nuclei-prep day as block.
reference_plan.layout: Same root zone and harvest time for ATAC and RNA-seq from the same plants.
reference_plan.randomization: Treatments processed together each prep day.
reference_plan.analysis: Consensus peaks (IDR) -> counts -> DESeq2 with prep day; link peaks to nearby genes' expression changes.
pitfalls: Crude nuclei with heavy organellar contamination

notes: Maize nuclei sort cleanly (~98% nuclear reads with FANS in Lu et al.).

prompt: GWAS gave us 5 candidate genes in sorghum. We want to validate them in silico and in vivo, with CRISPR knockouts in sorghum and heterologous expression in Arabidopsis.

source.citation: Design logic; Kaelin 2017, Nat Rev Cancer (validation pitfalls); Giambartolomei et al. 2014 for in silico prioritisation
source.basis: Independent alleles, sibling controls, in silico as prioritisation

reference_plan.design: Step 1 in silico: colocalization, expression in the trait tissue, orthology/synteny, variant effect -> rank 5 candidates. Step 2 sorghum: >=2 independent CRISPR alleles per top gene vs azygous siblings. Step 3 Arabidopsis: >=2 independent T3 lines per gene vs empty vector, ideally in the ortholog mutant (complementation).
reference_plan.layout: Each organism in RCBD (greenhouse benches / chamber shelves as blocks).
reference_plan.replication: Plants per line per block set by power on the trait; lines nested in allele.
reference_plan.randomization: Within block; phenotyping blinded to genotype.
reference_plan.analysis: phenotype ~ genotype + (1|line) + block per organism; pre-specified direction of effect.
pitfalls: Wild-type from another seed lot as control

notes: The crop experiment is the definitive test; the model organism adds independent support.

prompt: We found 3 candidate genes in mice and want to confirm them with knockouts in mice and RNAi in flies.

source.citation: Burnett et al. 2011 (controls/background); Lazic et al. 2018 (experimental units)

reference_plan.design: Mice: knockout vs wild-type littermates (litter as block). Flies: 2 independent RNAi lines per gene with GAL4/+ and UAS/+ controls in the same background.
reference_plan.layout: Mixed-genotype cages; fly vials blocked by rearing bottle.
reference_plan.replication: Mice: litters as units; flies: vials as units.
reference_plan.analysis: Per organism mixed models with litter/vial random effects.
pitfalls: Off-target RNAi without a second line

notes: Planning recommendation only; IACUC review required.
